items.title: Don Alias interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 6, 2002
items.q: Do you know the bass player Charles Frichtell?

ctx.x: Glad to hear that. Well I learned a lot from him too actually. So I think in one respect, you must have taught me a few things through him.
We had so much fun. You ought to let him tell you the fun that we used to have. Do you know the bass player Charles Frichtell?
